f2.help.stdout.value:
Usage: cdd [options] [command]

the CDD engine's command line

Options:
  --dry-run            preview the next dispatch step and its expected artifacts
                       — zero repo writes, no round consumed
                       (implement/review/fix/init)
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  implement [options]  run the task implement phase — at most 3 tasks per wave
  review [options]     run a review — wave | branch | phase-spec | overall |
                       plan | single-spec
  fix [options]        fix review findings — wave | branch | phase-spec |
                       overall | plan | single-spec
  base [options]       read/write base.json (single CDD --plan target)
  schema [options]     read canonical doc-structure schemas (discovery, zero
                       enforcement)
  issue [options]      aggregate issue-body rendering (cdd issue render, zero
                       enforcement)
  board [options]      render the progress board from a --plan or --spec entry
                       (overall/phase-spec/single-spec/plan/wave/branch)
  init [options]       install or update the kairos plugin set for a harness
  help [command]       display help for command
Examples:
  cdd implement --tasks 1,2 --plan <path>
  cdd review --type phase-spec --spec <path>
  cdd fix --type wave --tasks 1 --reviews .kairos/cdd/<slug>/tasks-1-review-1.json
  cdd base set --plan <path> --base develop --source plan-field
  cdd schema get phase-spec
  cdd issue render < findings.json
  cdd board --plan <path>
  cdd init --harness=claude
program flags (accepted at any position): --dry-run (implement/review/fix/init)
